# Bulk Image Downloader

> Bulk Image Downloader is a free Chrome extension that finds the images on a web page and lets you download them in bulk.

## What it does (as described on the homepage)

- Detects the images on the current page, including thumbnails and high-resolution versions
- Filter images by size, format, or source; sort by dimensions or file size before downloading
- Batch-download all selected images at once, with automatic file naming
- Floating widget for quick access on any website
- Price: free

## Install

- [Chrome Web Store listing](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/bulk-image-downloader/kbafpfajhhaeilcldcmmjbgjlecnbfgj): install the extension in Chrome
- After installing: click the Extensions (puzzle-piece) icon in the Chrome toolbar, pin "Bulk Image Downloader", then click its icon on any page where you want to download images

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://bulk-image-downloader.com/): features and use cases
